full_judgment:
1. Land (as per Joint Inventory): 22.90 Acres (As per Master Layout) J.L. No. 129, Khatian No. 44/KAT, Dag No. 69 And 107, Mouja, Masimpur, P.S.Tongi, Gazipur 

 30. According to Mr. Mahmud, the plot numbers as mentioned in this deed are C.S plots. However, in this schedule, it is not mentioned whether the khatian No. 44/KAT, Dag Nos. 69 and 107 of Mouza Masimpur are C.S khatian/plots. Anyway, the other side i.e. HRPB admits it to be C.S plots. From this document, it appears that some land and properties measuring an area of 22.90 acres of C.S. Plot Nos. 69 and 107 were sold by the Government. But on careful scrutiny of the C.S map, it transpires that neither C.S Plot No. 69 nor C.S Plot No. 107 is situated beside the main river Turag.
